recommendations.name: Risk-based triage with backpressure
recommendations.description: Route PRs by risk (peer check for small low-risk changes, senior review for new logic or API changes, pair review for auth, payments or infrastructure) and pause agent PR generation when more than five are pending per reviewer; the evidence is small (three teams, about 180 PRs) and observational.

recommendations.name: AI pre-review with intent-based grouping and context
recommendations.description: Run an AI pre-review on every PR that posts a summary and inline findings with reasoning traces, and group related changes so human reviewers spend their time on architecture, security-sensitive and high-risk areas.

recommendations.name: Automated checks and policy gates before human review, with smaller PRs
recommendations.description: Let automated quality, security, coverage and policy checks clear the routine issues first and cap PR size so humans only review architecture and correctness; this is a vendor post, so treat its statistics as indicative.
